At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard — from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next-generation safety and entertainment features. Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale.

The Role
At General Motors, we empower Product Managers to solve challenging customer and business problems. We seek passionate and innovative team members who can collaborate effectively within product management, program management, design, and engineering teams to discover and deliver impactful solutions. We hold our teams accountable for results and seek leaders who can influence teammates, stakeholders, and executives using data and logic.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the strategy, definition, and development of one of the products within Automated Driving and Active Safety (ADAS). This role involves identifying market opportunities, driving product vision, strategies, and roadmaps within the ADAS team’s broader objectives. You will play a key role in GM’s vision of a world with Zero Crashes and our transformation to industry leadership in software & services.

Join GM and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of automotive safety and driving innovation in the ADAS domain.

- Incorporate data, research, and market analysis to inform product strategies and roadmaps
- Establish and prioritize product requirements to solve critical business and customer problems.

- Define, track, and analyze key product metrics, user feedback, and performance data to measure success and identify improvement areas.
- Serve as a subject matter expert for your product portfolio, providing guidance to internal teams and external partners.
- Communicate product status and updates to senior leadership and stakeholders.
- Evangelize and build consensus with across colleagues and third parties
- Foster a culture of innovation and excellence.
- Stay updated on new technology and competitive products to drive continuous improvement, anticipate threats, and identify risks

- Experience working on a global team

- Experience working with data scientists and AI/ML teams on software development tools, pipelines, and release
- Experience handling regulatory, compliance, and legal requirements
- Experience fostering innovation and driving change in complex organizations

Job Description
The Role
The Senior Product Owner will lead the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery execution for key GM Motorsports data and analytics products that support Strategy, Vehicle Performance, and Competition Engineering - across NASCAR, IndyCar, and other GM racing programs . The role combines product ownership with scrum leadership responsibilities, partnering closely with motorsports stakeholders and leading cross-functional delivery across the data science and data engineering teams. Direct motorsports experience is not required; success in this role depends on the ability to quickly understand stakeholder needs, translate them into roadmaps and backlog items, and drive high-quality, timely delivery in a complex, fast-paced environment.

What You’ll Do
- Serve as the accountable Product Owner for cross-functional data science and data engineering teams supporting GM Motorsports.

- Own and maintain the product vision, roadmap, and prioritized backlog for motorsports analytics and data products, aligning to business strategy and measurable outcomes.

- Act as scrum lead for both teams:
- Facilitate and continuously improve backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.

- Ensure clear, well-defined user stories and acceptance criteria.

- Remove impediments and protect the teams’ ability to execute.

- Partner closely with motorsport Strategy, Vehicle Performance, and Competition Engineering stakeholders to:
- Understand business objectives, workflows, and decision-making needs.

- Translate complex requirements into clear, implementable features and experiments.

- Weigh scope, risk, and downstream impacts to recommend sequencing and trade-offs.

- Collaborate with data scientists, data engineers, architects, and product partners to define solutions that are feasible, scalable, and aligned with enterprise data and AI standards.

- Drive cross-functional alignment across multiple groups (e.g., motorsport engineering, IT, security, operations) to ensure dependencies are identified and managed.

- Communicate product strategy, priorities, risks, and status effectively:
- Provide concise, insights-driven updates and recommendations to senior and executive leadership.

- Provide clear context, rationale, and direction to delivery teams.

- Apply a disciplined approach to outcome measurement by defining and tracking product KPIs and adoption metrics, and using data and stakeholder feedback to iterate on roadmap and backlog priorities.

- Serve as a thought partner on data and AI capabilities, helping stakeholders understand what is possible with modern data science and data engineering platforms.

- Model and reinforce GM Behaviors (Win with Integrity, Commit to Customers, Innovate and Embrace Change, Speak Fearlessly, Move with Urgency, Be Inclusive, Lead as One Team, Own the Outcome) in day-to-day work and team interactions.

- Provide informal leadership and mentoring to other product owners, analysts, and team members; contribute to improving product and agile practices across the broader organization.

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data/Analytics, Business, or related field; or equivalent experience.

- Significant experience in product management / product ownership roles, including:
- Defining product vision and multi-release roadmaps .

- Managing and prioritizing complex backlogs across multiple stakeholder groups.

- Delivering digital/data products in an agile environment.

- Demonstrated experience serving as a Product Owner and/or scrum lead for one or more agile teams (e.g., data, analytics, software ).

- Proven ability to work cross-functionally and influence without formal authority, including partnering with technical and non-technical stakeholders at multiple levels.

- Strong communication skills with a track record of:
- Presenting concise, data-informed updates and recommendations to senior leadership.

- Translating technical concepts into business-relevant language for non-technical stakeholders.

- Providing clear, actionable guidance to development teams.

- Familiarity with data science and data engineering concepts (e.g., analytics use cases, data pipelines, model development and deployment, experimentation ) sufficient to:
- Ask the right questions.

- Understand trade-offs and constraints.

- Make informed prioritization decisions.

- Demonstrated ability to operate at a senior scope by:
- Solving complex, often new problems that require deep experience and strategic thinking.

- Leading large or high-visibility initiatives with cross-functional impact.

- Mentoring less-experienced colleagues and elevating team practices.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)
- Experience working with and owning data-heavy products or platforms in partnership with data science and/or data engineering teams (e.g., performance analytics, telemetry, operations ), including defining SLAs, data contracts, and quality expectations for downstream consumers.

- Familiarity with modern data and analytics technology stacks , ideally including:
- Cloud platforms (e.g., Azure ).

- Data engineering tools (e.g., Databricks, Spark, modern data pipelines, streaming technologies such as Kafka ).

- Analytics / BI / experimentation and ML platforms .

- Solid understanding of modern data engineering concepts and patterns ( data lakes/lakehouse, batch and streaming pipelines, warehousing, orchestration, observability ), with the ability to discuss trade-offs with engineers.

- Formal agile training or certifications (e.g., CSPO, PSPO, Scrum Master ) and experience tailoring agile practices to complex, multi-team environments.

General Motors pioneers the innovations that move and connect people to what matters. We see a world with zero crashes, zero emissions, and zero congestion.

Job Description

The Role
The Product Owner / Tool Developer will lead the technical integration of third party application connections that will enable GM’s Simulation Process Data Management (SPDM) ecosystem. The role will develop and maintain connections between third-party CAE applications and Scale, GM’s SPDM platform, while also integrating internally developed engineering tools (such as iNSPIRE).

INSPIRE provides governed storage, metadata, traceability, permissions, APIs, and user workflows for engineering analysis data used in virtual development and launch. The platform supports simple scalar data, dynamic structured data, complex parent-child data such as motor maps, and Virtual Vehicle assemblies that connect curated records to program, model year, milestone, and tracking vehicle attributes.

This position will serve as the accountable business lead for the INSPIRE product lifecycle and the primary connection between engineering data providers and consumers, GEOS leadership, GM IT, vehicle programs, domain technical experts, and software vendors. The successful candidate will translate engineering needs into an actionable product roadmap by understanding the technical requirements of both Scale and INSPIRE stakeholders.

The role will also help establish future capabilities in Multi-Discipline Integration and Optimization (MDIO), enabling broader integration of cross-domain analysis, optimization, and engineering workflows.

- Develop integrations between third-party CAE applications and Scale using Scale APIs and approved integration frameworks.

The Safety Assurance for Effective Autonomous Driving Software (SAFE-ADS) department is part of GM’s Global Product Safety, System, and Certification (GPSSC) organization. SAFE-ADS serves as a central body for automated driving system (ADS) safety assurance, bringing together technical expertise from across the company to support the safe development, testing, launch, and continuous improvement of advanced driving capabilities.

GM is seeking an Autonomous Vehicle Safety Case Technical Program Manager to lead the integrated execution of complex, cross-functional safety cases for ADS. This senior/staff individual contributor will bring structure, momentum, and transparency to the workstreams that support GM’s ADS safety case and safety assurance strategy.
The role will coordinate technical and operational work across safety case management, safety and risk management systems, operational safety and human factors, aggregate safety and rules-of-the-road metrics, counterfactual simulation, and related system-safety interfaces. The successful candidate will connect strategy to execution: translating safety objectives into actionable plans, aligning claims and sufficiency criteria with evidence and assessments, managing dependencies and risks, and driving decisions to closure across engineering, validation, operations, legal, public policy, and product teams.

This role is ideal for an experienced program leader who is comfortable operating in a technically complex, safety-critical environment; can synthesize diverse inputs into a coherent execution plan; and is motivated by the challenge of enabling the safe, measurable, and scalable deployment of ADS technology.

What You’ll Do
Integrated Program Leadership
- Build and maintain integrated program plans covering safety case workstreams, milestones, dependencies, resource needs, risks, decisions, and deliverables.

- Establish operating rhythms, governance forums, status reporting, action tracking, decision logs, and escalation paths that enable effective cross-functional execution.

- Align safety case claims with ADS product, engineering, validation, operational, and launch milestones.

- Translate evolving safety strategies and program objectives into clear workstream charters, measurable outcomes, delivery plans, and ownership models.

- Identify schedule, scope, technical, evidence, resource, and cross-functional dependency risks; drive mitigation plans and escalate issues when needed.

- Create clear, concise communications for technical teams, senior leaders, and cross-functional decision forums.

Safety Case and Assurance Execution
- Coordinate the development, assessment, maintenance, and continuous improvement of ADS safety cases across product-launch contexts.

- Drive alignment among safety claims, sufficiency criteria, evidence plans, assessment activities, and program milestones.

- Establish and maintain traceability between safety strategies, claims, requirements, evidence, assessments, decisions, and changes in system scope or operating conditions.

- Coordinate technical inputs from AI/ML, autonomy, systems engineering, functional safety, SOTIF, cybersecurity, software validation, simulation, human factors, operations, and product safety teams.

- Track evidence readiness, assessment status, substantiation gaps, deviations, and corrective actions; ensure gaps are closed, actively managed, or supported by documented rationale.

- Support impact assessments when the ADS, operational design domain, platform, release, feature behavior, or deployment plan changes.

- Improve the processes, tools, and information flows used to manage the safety case and safety assurance lifecycle.

- Use program data and operational feedback to identify systemic issues, improve process health, and increase predictability of safety assurance delivery.
